name: Isophyne

abilityDetails.Fractured Power Bar: Şampiyon, elindeki güç barına göre farklı özel saldırı türlerini belirli olasılıklarla kullanır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Energy Vulnerability: Enerji Direncini azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen enerji hasarını artırır.
abilityDetails.Wither: Rakibin güç kazanma ve iyileşme etkilerini zayıflatır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Marked: Regeneration, Immortality, Indestructible ve Death Immunity etkilerinin yetenek doğruluğunu %100 azaltır.

signatureAbility:
The Living Iso-sphere
Isophyne will not let any Cosmic threats escape their fate. When a Cosmic Opponent's Health drops below 10%, inflict an indefinite 125% Marked Passive.
As an Attacker, activating a Special Attack grants Isophyne a non-stacking Regeneration Passive, healing [0.3 - 0.6]% of missing Health for each Ego Passive over 4 seconds.
Isophyne starts each fight with a Power Gain Passive, granting [33 - 99]% of a Bar of Power over 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Mystical Eidol Physiology - Always Active
content: Isophyne is an Mystic Eidol and thus has a Fractured Power Bar and is Immune to Bleed, Coldsnap, and Frostbite effects.

Isophyne's mystical physiology causes their attacks to deal Energy Damage, and they benefit from Rank 3 of the Mystic Dispersion Mastery when it is not activated. However, their Combat Power Rate is reduced by 25%.
Both Champion's Light Attacks have a 35% chance to Nullify 1 Buff on Isophyne's Opponent. If the Opponent has a Pierce effect active, this becomes a 70% chance to Nullify.
Whenever any of Isophyne's personal Nullify abilities activate, but the Opponent does not have any Buffs active, gain an Instant Power Gain granting 10% of a Bar of Power, or 3.5% as a Defender.

abilitySections.title: Ever Evolving Ego
content: Ego Passives last for 3.5 seconds and expire one at a time, paused during Special Attacks. Max stacks: 10.
Gain 2 Ego Passives whenever Isophyne crosses a Bar of Power.
Gain 1 Ego Passive whenever Isophyne Nullifies a Buff.

abilitySections.title: Ego Effects
content: Ego Passives grant Isophyne the following effects:
+[1,974.32] Attack Rating.
+[99.74] Energy Resistance.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The first hit inflicts a [583.33] Energy Vulnerability Passive for 14 seconds, paused during Special Attacks and Strikers. When activated while above 2 Bars of Power, an additional Energy Vulnerability is inflicted. Max: 8.
The final hit Nullifies 2 Buffs on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The final hit inflicts a non-stacking 100% Wither Passive for 24 seconds. While active, whenever Isophyne triggers a Nullify, they trigger an additional Nullify.
If activated after hitting the Opponent's Block with a Medium or Light Attack, this Special Attack becomes Passively Unblockable.
For each Ego Passive active on Isophyne, they gain a +[2,347.84] Fury Passive for the duration of the Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a Degeneration Passive dealing [69,368] Direct Damage over 35 seconds, paused during Special Attacks. This damage is increased by 10% for each personal Energy Vulnerability Passive on the Opponent.
While this Degeneration Passive is active, Isophyne's Special Attack 1 inflicts an additional Energy Vulnerability Passive.
